iosLaunchAcceptancePolicy: Accept only the applicable iOS journeys and declared creation capabilities on final public-backend/physical-device artifacts, plus an iOS/backend workload profile declared and frozen before measurement with security, abuse, restore/rollback and cost gates. This separate milestone does not approve the retained mixed-platform profile or six-platform global flags; monthly availability still requires 30 observed days.
validationPolicy: Implement coherent front/core/backend batches, review then validate once together. Repeat broad checks/builds only when code changes, failures or unresolved concerns justify it; preserve integrity/auth/durability assertions and record environment failures separately.
referencePolicy: Telegram iOS is the principal UI and interaction reference; Signal is the principal reliability reference. Evaluate maintained OSS/library reuse independently. Expo remains the product interface and Rust the shared authority; no duplicate durable store is introduced.
completionScope: Thirty requiredJourneys plus all declared creationWorkspace capabilities and the numerical operating envelope. Competitor quality is a design reference, not an unbounded all-features/global-scale acceptance target.
currentFocus: User-confirmed priority: agents and conversation only. Complete the selected Telegram iOS interface/interactions and corresponding backend before resuming Apps or shared creation. Preserve all approved final-product scope.
